sources.snippet: Multi-agent AI system for diabetes medical Q&A, built on LangGraph. Users ask diabetes-related questions in Vietnamese. The system triages for safety, routes to specialized agents, retrieves evidence from a local vector DB and the live web, then synthesizes a cited, markdown-formatted answer.
